name: Composer
summary: Where a person writes to an assistant: one box holding what they've added (pictures and files), the text, and a toolbar with an add menu (files and tools), the chosen tool, dictation and Send, which turns into Stop while a reply arrives. The box grows with the text from one line, then scrolls. Not for a comment or a form's long answer (TextArea), or for chat between people.
a11y: A TextArea named by `label` (hidden), with the attachments as a labelled list above the text and the toolbar after it in Tab order. Icon-only buttons are named ("Add files and tools", "Dictate", "Send message", "Stop replying"); Send is focusable but unavailable, with its reason, while there's nothing to send or an upload is running. Replying is announced once by the TextArea and shown in words under the box, never only by the gradient.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the box for assistive technology; not shown (the page makes plain what the box is for). Default "Message".

props.name: value
props.description: The text being written.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Sends the text, the attachments and the chosen tool. Called by Enter and Send, only when there's something to send and nothing is still uploading. Clear `value` and `attachments` yourself once it's taken.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example of what to ask, never instructions. Default "Ask anything".

props.name: replying
props.description: A reply is arriving: the box's ring turns the AI gradient (Q56), the words say what's happening, and Send becomes Stop. The text stays editable for the next message.

props.name: replyingLabel
props.description: Present tense while replying: "Writing a reply" (default), "Creating an image".

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stops the reply; shown in Send's place while `replying`.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Pictures and files added so far, in the order they were added.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Files chosen through "Add photos and files", dropped on the composer or pasted into the text. Without it, the menu doesn't offer files.

props.name: accept
props.description: What files the picker offers, as the `accept` attribute: "image/*,.pdf". Default any.

props.name: tools
props.description: Tools offered in the add menu, after files.

props.name: tool
props.description: The chosen tool's value, shown as a chip in the box.

props.name: onToolChange
props.description: A tool chosen, or `undefined` when its chip is removed.

props.name: onDictate
props.description: Dictation: shows the microphone.

props.name: disclaimer
props.description: One quiet line under the box, centred: "Answers can be wrong. Check important facts."

props.name: id
props.description: Stable, for Remove and Retry.

props.name: name
props.description: The file's name, as the person saved it: "floor-plan.pdf".

props.name: src
props.description: Images: the picture's address (an object URL while it uploads).

props.name: type
props.description: Files: the type in words, "PDF", "Spreadsheet".

props.name: state
props.description: `uploading` (Send waits for it), `failed` (with Retry) or `ready` (default).

props.name: label
props.description: A verb or a noun phrase, sentence case: "Create image".

props.name: description
props.description: One short line in the menu: what the tool does.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shown on the chosen tool's chip.
